{{Top|leg}}
'''Crawler One''' was an [[Icecrawler/Legends|icecrawler]] used on the planet [[Syned]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It serviced the [[Arkadianate]] capital of [[Calimondretta]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] used one of these icecrawlers to transport [[Jarrow Rusher]] back to the troopship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] since she intended to take the student refugees aboard the ship as Arkadianate subjects. It was piloted by a male [[Unidentified Nazzar icecrawler driver|Nazzar icecrawler driver]]. However, Rusher hijacked the vehicle and used it as a "trojan horse" during the [[Siege of Calimondretta]]. During the assault, "Crawler One" carried two artillery cannons including "[[Bitsy (laser cannon)|Bitsy]]."
